measured_gaps.derivation: source panel bottom 930 minus actual counter worktop top 860
measured_gaps.meaning: Uncovered wall band, not a modeled open cavity. Panels are separated horizontally from counter rear by about 4.5–5 mm; watertight junction is absent.
measured_gaps.acceptance: HOLD: not acceptable as an unprotected wet/grease band; actual wall substrate, worktop/upstand and sealing need site survey.

measured_gaps.derivation: upper underside 1480 minus source panel top 1450
measured_gaps.meaning: Exposed wall band only where the panel and saved upper overlap along the wall. West-low cabinet overlaps the panel for only about 92 mm; source extents do not automatically form a complete L corner.
measured_gaps.acceptance: Finish continuity needed; not a structural void or a cabinet fabrication tolerance.

measured_gaps.derivation: fixed ceiling 2500 minus saved upper top 2180
measured_gaps.meaning: Open wall/head space, not omitted cabinetry.
measured_gaps.acceptance: Retain open. Cleanable wall finish and safe access to cabinet tops; no new cabinet, bulkhead, cornice or ceiling drop.

measured_gaps.derivation: hood lower bound 1550 minus proposed general panel finish top 1480
measured_gaps.meaning: Additional exposed wall behind cooking zone; hob burner geometry begins around 874 and extends higher. 676 mm is the difference to the nominal hob reference, not a certified minimum from burner/pan/support top.
measured_gaps.acceptance: HOLD: gas/electric manufacturer clearance and extraction installation must confirm any actual hood/finish geometry.

notes: Nominal flush matching removable lower 70 mm and upper 30 mm finish skins use existing 5 mm panel depth/width; separate 70 mm cooking-zone skin reaches hood proxy underside. These are visual extents, not cut sizes.
Prefer a continuous washable heat/moisture-compatible facing when site fabrication allows; removable strip rendering illustrates coverage and does not approve multiple dirt-trapping joints.

Non-porous matte/satin light finish; flush closed edges, compatible flexible sealed worktop junction, no open capillary path. Adhesive, sealant, substrate waterproofing, expansion, thermal rating and tolerances supplied by installer/material maker.
Corner and panel ends are not coincident; survey return and end exposures before cutting. Do not extend a panel through an opening, heat clearance, socket or ventilation path.
Keep optics/profile accessible without removing cabinet or hood filter. No electrical components buried behind the proposed skins.
